Subject: Mosaic - post-discovery engineer handoff and integration deep-dive

Hi Sara / Thomas —

Thanks again for the productive discovery session yesterday. Per our conversation, the best next step is a focused engineer handoff + technical deep-dive between your infra team and our pre-sales engineering group so we can map network, auth, and the expected token/seq throughput for your ingestion pipeline.

Proposed 60–90 minute windows (all times PT):
- Thu Mar 11: 9:00–10:30 or 11:30–13:00
- Fri Mar 12: 8:30–10:00 or 14:00–15:30

If none of those work, please share 2–3 times that do. Also let us know:
- who from your side will join (security/network/ops)
- any must-cover agenda items (SAML, egress restrictions, KV cache persistence, quantized model perf)

I attached a one‑pager agenda stub to start. If you'd like, Ben will lead the session and Olga will own the post-call runbook. Karthik will attend for model/quantization questions.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0129

- can you share a short network diagram or example run-of-show?
- we will have a vendor-security rep on the call; they may ask for a short SOC2 evidence summary before the session.
